Proposition
[The six essential surfaces] \group 3-manifold topology Source: thurston:page-0083, thurston:page-0084 For the figure-eight knot exterior $M$, the six distinguished connected incompressible and $\partial $-incompressible surfaces are: the boundary-parallel torus $S_1$; a punctured torus Seifert surface $S_2$ with boundary slope $(0,\pm 1)$; two punctured Klein bottles $S_3,S_5$; and the boundaries $S_4,S_6$ of their tubular neighborhoods, each a twice-punctured torus with slope $(\pm 4,1)$.
